Frozen heavens above

It’s crazy how looking up at the night sky can have a way of freezing time in its tracks, of stretching a single moment into infinity.

ArtView full archive ↗

About this piece

It’s crazy how looking up at the night sky can have a way of freezing time in its tracks, of stretching a single moment into infinity.

Sometimes we just need to stop and look.
